subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The school bus driver kept a list of students and their stops.”?
options: One rainy afternoon, a student named Alice left her science project on the bus.
The next day, the student returned the umbrella with another one.
One day, a student named Ray fell asleep on the bus.
One day, a new student named Jason came into the classroom.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「One rainy afternoon, a student named Alice left her science project on the bus.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The next day, the student returned the umbrella with another one.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「One day, a student named Ray fell asleep on the bus.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「One day, a new student named Jason came into the classroom.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「One day, a student named Ray fell asleep on the bus.」，答案為「One day, a student named Ray fell asleep on the bus.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「One day, a student named Ray fell asleep on the bus.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
